editorial:
Imagine you have to break into a spooky old house during a huge party just to save your dad. That is exactly what happens here. You get to follow three siblings who are all experts at different tricks. One is a magician, one can escape from anything, and one is a pro at lying and swindling. They have to work together to steal a mummy that is worth a fortune. The whole thing takes place during the Night of the Dead, so the vibe is a mix of a heist movie and a spooky celebration. It feels like a fun family adventure where the stakes are high but the jokes keep flowing.

You will really enjoy how the movie keeps you guessing with its twists and fast pace. The acting feels natural, and the chemistry between the siblings makes the story work. While some of the plot points are a bit predictable, the action scenes are exciting and well-done. It is a perfect pick for a movie night with friends.
endingExplained: After a wild chase, the siblings manage to swap the real mummy with a fake one using their magic tricks. They escape the hacienda just in time and sell the mummy to a private collector. The money they make allows them to pay for their father's expensive medical treatment, saving his life. In the end, the siblings realize that their bond is more valuable than the money, and they decide to start a legal magic business together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves heist movies and family comedies.
